title: Suigadan
body:
Syntax: perform suigadan <target>

Description: A water attack that requires a natural water source in the room.  Requires Water chakra nature. Requires water in the room (ocean, river, lake, or swamp). Base damage: 62-71. Unlocks at level 30. Costs 28 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
